claim: ADR 0019 requires one error envelope. An exception from the kernel that is not a ServiceException (the service test proves it propagates) leaves POST /canon/compute as Starlette's plain-text 500; no endpoint test covers the path, so neither the missing envelope nor a later leak of the exception text would be noticed.
evidence: Measured in the copy with KERNEL.compute raising LookupError and TestClient(raise_server_exceptions=False): '500 text/plain; charset=utf-8 Internal Server Error'. app/main.py registers handlers for ServiceException, IntegrityError and RequestValidationError only.
recommended_test: Fast tier, test_canon_endpoint.py with TestClient(application, raise_server_exceptions=False): monkeypatch canon_service.KERNEL to a facade whose compute raises RuntimeError('boom /private/var/x'); POST {'aircraft': {'fleet': 'bryan'}, 'quantities': ['stall-speed']}; assert status 500, response.json()['error']['code'] == 'internal_error', and '/private' not in response.text. The test fails today: it documents a production gap, to be fixed in production.
